# CS Ventures

CS Ventures enables individuals and small businesses to create new products, optimize business processes, gain more traction in their markets, and identify new opportunities.

Founded and operated by Carter Shannon, a strategy and analytics professional based in Washington, D.C.

Website: https://cs-ventures.us

---

## Carter Shannon

Carter Shannon works at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and product. He is a consultant at Deloitte's Government and Public Sector practice and the founder of CS Ventures, based in Washington, D.C.

Technology has automated the deterministic layer of business. Data pipelines run without analysts. Decisions that once required teams now happen in real time. The bottleneck has shifted from execution to judgment. Carter works at that gap: knowing which problem is worth solving, building the system that solves it, and driving it to delivery.

His path spans financial diligence and demand modeling at Logistics Capital and Strategy, public sector technology and analytics at Deloitte, go-to-market strategy for Anthropic's AI models in the federal market, and product development across AI agents, mobile apps, and analytical systems.

Contact: info@cs-ventures.us

### Skills

- Analytics: SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, Power BI
- Financial Modeling: Excel, P&L Analysis, Risk Assessment
- Strategy: Market Research, Demand Modeling, Go-to-Market
- Product: Workflow Design, Process Optimization, KPI Tracking

## Portfolio

### DeckForge

DeckForge is an autonomous AI agent that writes an equity research deck, critiques it, and rewrites it in a scoring loop until it is board-ready.

Give it a prompt. It pulls real numbers from public filings, builds the deck, then improves it until the composite score clears the ship bar. No manual iteration. No formatting passes. Just a finished deck.

Tags: AI Agent, Finance, Research Decks, Agentic Workflow
URL: https://cs-ventures.us/DeckForge/

### Product Film Agent

The Product Film Agent turns a product recording, brand system, runtime, and creative reference into a launch-ready motion film. It rebuilds the interface as animatable graphics, choreographs every interaction to a beat sheet, adds sound design, and rejects renders that fail still-frame, motion, or freeze-detection gates.

The Altro Trips launch film is the working example.

Tags: AI Agent, Motion Design, Remotion, Product Marketing, Quality Gates
URL: https://cs-ventures.us/portfolio/#product-film-agent
Example: https://cs-ventures.us/media/altro-trips-proof-v2.mp4

### Altro

Altro is a travel ranking app for logging cities, comparing past trips, and building a personal map of the places that still pull you forward.

Altro turns travel memories into a clear, ranked view of taste and return energy. Log every city you visit, rank and compare trips side by side, and build a living map colored by how strongly each place calls you back.

Tags: Travel, Rankings, Personal Map, Mobile
URL: https://cs-ventures.us/Altro/
App: https://cartershannon000-create.github.io/Altro-travel/marketing.html

### How to Build Your First App with AI

A beginner-friendly field guide for moving from an idea to a deployed application with an AI coding assistant. It covers product planning, local setup, living design documents, modular development loops, Git and GitHub, CI/CD, secret handling, and turning repeated prompts into reusable automation.

The guide includes a copyable SYSTEM_BLUEPRINT.md template that defines project intent, stack, environment, modular requirements, development protocol, deployment strategy, and an optional AI memory hook.

Tags: Guide, AI Development, App Architecture, Git, Deployment
URL: https://cs-ventures.us/how-to-build-your-first-app/

### Nos

Nos is a prayer and journaling app built around novenas, daily reflection, and honest journaling.

A quiet home for prayer whether the answer is yes, no, or not yet. Nos gives structure without pressure and beauty without clutter. No streaks, no guilt, no notifications that shame. Built around the reality that prayer is a relationship, not a performance metric.

Tags: Prayer, Journaling, Reflection, Mobile
URL: https://cs-ventures.us/Nos/
App: https://novena-prayer-app.github.io/nos-prayer-app/marketing.html
